title: Concept: Workflow secret interpolated into a run step in yaml — review required
description: In yaml, a run: step interpolates a secret expression directly into the command line. The runner expands it before execution, exposing the value to the job log, to child process argument lists, and to any debugging output the command emits. Masking reduces but does not remove that exposure, and a leaked deployment token stays valid after the job ends.
applicability: yaml workflows that deploy, publish, or call an authenticated API.
risk: Credential disclosure in CI logs and process arguments; HIGH severity.
